key.name: word-wrap
key.description: Wrap long lines at word boundaries

key.name: use-editorconfig
key.description: Apply .editorconfig files for per-file formatting settings

key.name: show-minimap
key.description: Whether an editor minimap appears on supported documents.

key.name: invisible-characters-mode
key.description: Default invisible-character visibility mode for newly opened editor tabs: 'off', 'whitespace-only', or 'all'.

key.name: minimap-width
key.description: Preferred minimap width in pixels for supported editor pages.

key.name: bookmark-gutter-visible
key.description: Whether bookmark indicators appear in the source view gutter

key.name: annotation-highlights-visible
key.description: Whether annotated line ranges are highlighted in the editor

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Adwaita color scheme: 'default' (follow system), 'force-light', or 'force-dark'

key.name: style-scheme
key.description: Base GtkSourceView style scheme ID (dark variant selected automatically)

key.name: tab-content-opacity
key.description: Opacity used for editor and Markdown preview document backgrounds, where 1.0 is fully opaque.

key.name: custom-font
key.description: Pango font description used when system font is disabled

key.name: zoom-level
key.description: Editor zoom as a percentage (100 = normal size)

key.name: split-view-layout-migrated
key.description: Whether legacy left-sidebar settings have been migrated to the split-view layout keys.

key.name: workspace-sidebar-visible
key.description: Whether the left workspace sidebar is visible in the split-view layout.

key.name: workspace-sidebar-width-fraction
key.description: Stored preset hint fraction for the adaptive workspace sidebar width chosen in Preferences.

key.name: properties-sidebar-visible
key.description: Whether the right properties sidebar is visible in the split-view layout.

key.name: properties-sidebar-width-fraction
key.description: Preferred fraction of the window width reserved for the properties sidebar.

key.name: sidebar-position
key.description: Legacy GtkPaned divider position in pixels, retained for one-shot split-view migration.

key.name: sidebar-visible
key.description: Legacy left-sidebar visibility, retained for one-shot split-view migration.

key.name: preview-pane-position
key.description: Markdown preview pane divider position in pixels from the right

key.name: preview-pane-visible
key.description: Whether the Markdown preview pane is visible

key.name: search-panel-visible
key.description: Whether the workspace search panel is visible.

key.name: search-case-sensitive
key.description: Whether workspace content search matches case

key.name: search-regex
key.description: Whether workspace content search uses regex patterns

key.name: search-whole-word
key.description: Whether workspace content search matches whole words only

key.name: search-panel-options-expanded
key.description: Whether the advanced options area in the search panel is expanded

key.name: search-gitignore
key.description: Whether workspace content search respects .gitignore patterns

key.name: workspace-auto-collapse
key.description: Automatically collapse other workspaces when focusing a folder

key.name: workspace-empty-folder-lookahead-cap
key.description: Maximum number of subdirectories to check for emptiness per scan
